rows.ARS:
Medium yellow Floribunda.
Registration name: Delbojaun
rows.Bloom: Yellow. Mild fragrance. Medium, double (17-25 petals), cluster-flowered bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit: Height: up to 32" (up to 80cm). Width: 16" to 2' (40 to 60cm).
rows.Growing: USDA zone 6b through 9b (default). Can be used for beds and borders.
rows.Parentage: If you know the parentage of this rose, or other details, please contact us.
